rules: Exact original fixture, saved numerical state, source, plan, driver and analysis bytes are retained.
Only the exact private experiment absolute pathname prefix is replaced in logs/ledgers containing it; raw hashes and replacement counts remain.
No binaries, targets, .git data, personal filesystem paths, proprietary assets or credentials are included.
The producer original inventory retains raw private artifact hashes; MANIFEST.json is the candidate closure inventory.
Historical files are copied byte-identically solely for source-bound mesh/shared-time comparison, not a new reference/quality result.
